slice.slice: Separate opt-in owned final-pose point-to-point correspondence and normal-matrix capture in Rust/core and Python plain LidarOdometry. Existing solver, report schema, worker equation format and defaults remain unchanged.
slice.api: Core set_capture_linearization(bool), capture_linearization(), last_linearization(); setting captured at begin. Python keyword-only capture_linearization=False, read-only property, copied last_linearization() dict. No IMU-frontend or WASM API addition in this slice.
slice.snapshot: Returned orthonormalized pose, fixed prediction rotation center, all selected sensor/world source points, matched source indices, actual matched map targets, squared distances, fixed Geman-McClure weights, raw J.T W J and -J.T W residual, weight sum and weighted RMS radius about that center. Include canonical inserted_world points and map settings for independent pre-insertion map replay.
slice.semantics: Recompute at the returned pose against the map before insertion using the existing native 27-voxel matcher. This is not the last attempted solve matrix. Parameters are translation xyz then world rotation xyz around the prediction center. No alignment eligibility yields an owned empty-match/zero-matrix snapshot with insertion data; disabled capture yields None.
slice.numerics: Capture is serial in source order. Existing parallel solver reduction and all pose/map arithmetic are untouched. Nonfinite diagnostic values are flagged and never repaired or fed back. Zero support/radius supplies no usable spectrum.
slice.real_inputs: Original flatwall bag and the same four saved 64-reference pose sequences/diagnostics from PR292/293. Declared zero gyro bias, identity extrinsic, acceleration scale 9.80665; compensated points use existing gyro-only API at the frozen maximum integer point references.
slice.execution: One fresh process with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1; cases run sequentially. Capture-disabled and capture-enabled poses/reports must reproduce all old 64 pose bits, reference times and reports per case.
slice.independent_checks: Scalar range/first-point thinning, independent complete 27-cell search (center first, strict distance ties), map capacity and first-point voxel pruning replay from canonical inserted points. Verify all selected points/matches and reconstruct fixed-weight J, normal matrix, right-hand side, weight sum and radius with NumPy.
slice.geometry_probe: On finite supported systems, D=diag(1,1,1,1/r,1/r,1/r); report eigvalsh(sym(D H D)/sum_w), where parameters are [translation, r*rotation] in metres. Keep raw negative roundoff; only presentation may clip values within 1e-12. Predeclare weak ratios below 1e-3, without inversion, damping, quality gating or state adoption.
slice.scope: The fixed-match point-to-point normal matrix is an uncalibrated conditional surrogate and can be full-rank on a physically degenerate plane. It is not calibrated covariance, GICP/plane information, physical observability, cause of initialization failure, ground-truth accuracy, timing or GPU execution. No initialization gate/default change or fitted-state adoption.
slice.regression: Run unchanged full-motion component and frontend controllers on the new private native. Preserve all prior successful controllers, protocols, source/binary snapshots and receipts verbatim.

scope: Conditional fixed-match uncalibrated point-to-point geometry only; no physical observability, covariance, GICP, accuracy, causal, timing or GPU claim.
